title: Singapore Short Break with Night Safari
alt: The Merlion fountain with the Marina Bay Sands towers behind it in Singapore
transport: Private airport transfers with shared coaches for tours and tickets

expert.name: Nisha Rao
expert.quote: Four days is enough for a first look at Singapore if you keep it to the city, the cable car and one wildlife evening.
expert.tip: Hotel Boss sits a short walk from Lavender MRT, so skip taxis and use the trains. Three days of travel cost less than one airport cab.

summary: A four day first look at Singapore. Wildlife by tram on arrival night, a half day city tour with a free afternoon, then the Sentosa cable car and Madame Tussauds before the flight home.
included: Included: 3 nights at Hotel Boss with daily breakfast; Night Safari with tram ride; half day city tour; two way cable car sky pass; Madame Tussauds with a digital photo; 8 private and shared transfers.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; lunches and dinners; entry to sights not named above; personal expenses.

day_titles.2: City tour and a free afternoon

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private sedan transfer to Hotel Boss
Check in and take a couple of hours to settle
Shared transfer out to Mandai for the Night Safari and its tram ride
Back in town for late supper on Beach Road near the hotel
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the half day city tour
Merlion Park, Marina Bay, Chinatown and the civic district
Afternoon at your own pace around Bugis and Orchard Road
Optional: the observation wheel at Marina Bay or a river bumboat at dusk
3: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Mount Faber station
Two way cable car sky pass across the harbour to Sentosa
Madame Tussauds with the Spirit of Singapore boat ride and a digital photo
Return shared transfer to the hotel in the evening
4: Private sedan transfer to Changi Airport for your flight home

stops.name: Singapore
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast included · Standard room · 4★ · Hotel Boss on Victoria Street, a short walk from Lavender MRT

program.name: A first look at the city
program.description: Three nights on the edge of Kampong Glam with the Night Safari, a city tour and the Sentosa cable car in easy reach.

activities.name: Night Safari with Tram Ride
activities.description: A tram circuit through the Mandai reserve after dark, past elephants, hyenas, leopards and the nocturnal houses.

activities.name: Half Day Singapore City Tour
activities.description: A shared coach tour of Merlion Park, Marina Bay, Chinatown and the old civic quarter with a local guide.

activities.name: Singapore Cable Car Sky Pass
activities.description: A round trip between Mount Faber, HarbourFront and Sentosa with the harbour and the islands below.

activities.name: Madame Tussauds Singapore
activities.description: Wax figures, the Spirit of Singapore boat ride through the city's history and a digital photo to take home.

activities.name: Singapore Flyer
activities.description: A half hour turn on the observation wheel at Marina Bay, with the Strait and the city laid out beneath you.
